messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - disclosure deadline next week
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to Kestrel, but flagging that the disclosure deadline in Bracken Group v Calderwood Industries (CL-2025-000412) falls on 12 March. Counsel (Rosenthal KC) wants a call before then to finalise the disclosure list. Are you free Tuesday afternoon?

Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
